parsed.post: Massive improvement! Increasing DEPTH to 8 with the 262144 batch size dropped val_bpb from 0.853872 to 0.838688. Capacity and optimizer steps are working well together. Next, I'll test increasing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 to see if we can stabilize even higher learning rates for further gains.
parsed.description: Increase WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 to test if more warmup allows for better convergence/stability at DEPTH 8.
